event.notes: Free admission; the event marks Ramzan Kadyrov's 50th birthday and Grozny City Day. 22 bouts: 5 main card + 12 prelims (on ACA's page) + 5 early prelims (Sherdog/Tapology/metaratings). Official weigh-in results were not yet published on 2026-10-01.

cardChanges.what: No cancellation, replacement, added bout or order change found as of 2026-10-01. The 22-bout card and order on Sherdog match metaratings' full card (2026-09-30 and 2026-10-01); ACA's own page shows the same top 17 in the same order.
Main event intact: ACA posted the headliners' first face-off in Grozny on 2026-10-01.
Title fight moved here from ACA 206 (2026-08-15) after both fighters were injured (Tumenov first, then Shaikhaev).

ACA posted the fight card one week out and said the 'originally planned number of bouts' and 'cancellations' are discussed in its 'Matchmakers ACA #3' video (chapter 'Who dropped off the Grozny card?!' at 02:14). Which fighters/bouts dropped off BEFORE the current 22-bout card was set is NOT verified - the video page could not be read.
ACA says Uzair Abdurakov had a change of opponent during camp (now Herbert Batista); original opponent not stated.
Sulumov vs Moraes is on ACA's page, Sherdog and metaratings but missing from Tapology (Tapology omission, not a cancellation).
Weight class is bantamweight per ACA (announcement + event page + rankings) and Sherdog; Tapology's 145 lb is wrong/stale.
Weight class: ACA's announcement, both ACA fighter profiles, Sherdog and Tapology say flyweight; only ACA's event page says bantamweight 61.7 kg. Treated as flyweight pending the weigh-in.
Tapology shows a duplicate 'cancelled' Dudaev-Vargas entry next to the confirmed bout; the bout is still on everywhere else.
Taygibov vs Selimkhanov is a rebooking of a bout cancelled from ACA 200 (2026-02-06).

notes.text: ACA lightweight title fight, 5 x 5. Shaikhaev is the champion making his FIRST defence. He won the interim belt on 2026-01-09 (ACA 198, UD over Herdeson Batista, 5 rounds) and was promoted to undisputed champion on 2026-04-11 when Abdul-Aziz Abdulvakhabov vacated to move to welterweight.
ACA's own news item calls it the first defence of Shaikhaev's lightweight title; Tumenov says he is going for a finish.

This fight was first booked for ACA 206 (Moscow, 2026-08-15) and was pulled after BOTH fighters were injured - Tumenov first, then Shaikhaev - and rebooked for ACA 208. (Source is the ACA 206 viewing guide; its exact publication day in August 2026 was not captured.)
Postponement from ACA 206 also reported here (no reason given).

Layoffs on fight night: Shaikhaev 268 days (last fought 2026-01-09); Tumenov 240 days (last fought 2026-02-06, TKO R1 over Aleksandr Grozin). Tumenov is on a 6-fight win streak, last four by stoppage.

Shaikhaev missed weight (159.1 lb) at ACA 188 on 2025-06-28 (Wikipedia footnote gives the surname only; Tapology shows Daud Shaikhaev fought Artem Reznikov on that card). He made 155.6 lb for the interim title fight in January 2026.
ACA ranks Tumenov #3 at lightweight (Abdulvakhabov is still listed #1, Ali Bagov #2). ACA says Abdulvakhabov vacated rather than fight his teammate Shaikhaev (both Berkut FC).
No previous meeting between the two (the '#3' in ACA's promo is Tumenov's ranking, not a trilogy).
Both headliners were face to face in Grozny on 2026-10-01 (ACA posted the first stare-down, 'title fight at lightweight') - the main event is intact as of that day.

notes.text: Co-main is 3 x 5 (Tapology lists '170, 3 x 5'); no ACA source states a round count.

Abdulvakhabov's welterweight debut. He vacated the ACA lightweight title in April 2026; ACA says he chose not to fight teammate Daud Shaikhaev. Last fight 2025-07-11 (KO of Ali Bagov, ACA 189) - a 450-day layoff. Age 37.
Abdulvakhabov says this is his first fight at welterweight and he only needs to cut 3-5 kg, while (his claim) Tibau cuts from about 95 kg.

Tibau is 43 (born 1983-07-10). Last MMA fight 2025-10-18 (submission win, WNC 3) - about 351 days ago; he is on a 3-fight win streak, with a middleweight bout in September 2024. No retirement statement found.

Tapology shows two Tibau MMA bookings cancelled in 2026 (vs Andrey Koreshkov 2026-06-06, vs Fanil Rafikov 2026-08-08) and two grappling matches (2026-07-05, 2026-08-08). Reasons for the cancellations not verified.

notes.text: Vargas was stopped in round 1 (TKO) by Nashkho Galaev on 2026-06-19 at ACA 204 - 107 days before this fight.

Dudaev last fought 2025-10-23 (decision win over Pavel Vitruk, ACA 194) - 346 days ago. Tapology lists that bout at 135 lb and this one at 145 lb, i.e. a move back up; ACA's own pages list him at featherweight. Treat the weight-class change as Tapology-only.
Tapology's 'Cancelled & Fizzled Bouts' box shows a duplicate Dudaev-Vargas entry while the same bout is also listed as confirmed (#20). ACA's page, Sherdog and metaratings all still list the bout.
This matchup was previously booked for ACA 200 (2026-02-06) and cancelled (reason not verified). Not a rematch - they have not fought.
ACA bills it as #2 vs #6 in the featherweight rankings.
Selimkhanov lost a decision to Alimardan Abdykaarov on 2026-05-08 (ACA 203); before that he stopped Rustam Kerimov in round 5 (2025-10-04). Taygibov has won two straight (TKO R2 on 2026-02-06).

Ibragimov is the former ACA light heavyweight champion; he lost the belt by TKO R2 to Muslim Magomedov on 2025-12-05 (ACA 197) and has not fought since (303 days). His last three fights were all 5-rounders; this is 3 x 5.
Starodub has won three straight, including Evgeny Erokhin (submission R2, 2026-03-27, Fight of the Night) and Husein Kushagov (decision, 2025-11-23) - both of whom are also on this card.

WEIGHT CLASS RESOLVED: bantamweight. ACA's announcement calls it a clash of 'two TOPs of bantamweight' (legchayshego vesa); the ACA event page lists 61.7 kg; Sherdog says bantamweight; ACA ranks Podlesniy #3 and Kerimov #4 at bantamweight. Tapology's '145' is the outlier.

Kerimov is DROPPING BACK to bantamweight: his last three fights were at featherweight (TKO win 2025-04-11; TKO loss R5 to Dzhambulat Selimkhanov 2025-10-04; decision win over David Dzhibilov 2026-03-27, weighing in at 146.9 lb).
Podlesniy's last fight was the ACA bantamweight title fight vs Josiel Silva on 2026-03-27 (ACA 201), ruled a No Contest after an accidental eye poke in round 2. He has not fought since (191 days).
No odds found for this bout.
REMATCH: Dzhanaev beat Dolgov by unanimous decision at ACA 148 on 2022-11-18.
Dzhanaev was stopped (TKO R1) by Edil Esengulov on 2026-07-17 at ACA 205 - only 79 days before this fight.
Dolgov is on a three-fight losing streak (decision 2024-12-15, TKO R1 2025-05-10, decision 2026-03-27).
Grishenko's ACA 206 bout vs Mohammed Usman (2026-08-15) was cancelled (reason not verified); his last fight was 2026-03-27 (decision over Klidson Abreu).
Matsola was stopped (TKO R1) by Khadis Ibragimov on 2026-04-12 (ACA 202), his only pro loss; 175 days ago.

DISCREPANCY RESOLVED: the bout is ON. It is on ACA's own event page (checked 2026-10-01), on Sherdog, and in metaratings' full-card lists of 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-01. Tapology simply omits it (lists 21 bouts, numbering skips #14). Round count (3) assumed from ACA's non-title standard - Tapology has no entry for this bout.
Sulumov withdrew injured from his ACA 200 bout vs Artem Reznikov (reported 2026-01-30); he then lost a decision to Alexander Matmuratov on 2026-06-19 (ACA 204).
Moraes (ex-UFC/PFL) last fought 2025-10-24 (split-decision win for a lightweight title) - about 345 days ago; his fight before that (2025-08-15) was a decision loss at featherweight.

ACA's fight-week episode on Abdurakov says he is 'returning after surgery', trained at a mountain camp, and had a 'change of opponent'. Neither the type of surgery nor the original opponent is stated in the post (video not viewed).
Abdurakov has lost two straight, both by submission: R1 to Zhakshylyk Myrzabekov (interim welterweight title, 2025-12-05) and R3 to Eduard Vartanyan (2026-04-12, ACA 202).
Local report: Abdurakov is holding his camp in Dagestan (publication date not captured).

Boraev has a recent weight problem: he missed weight at ACA 198 on 2026-01-09 (149.2 lb), and Tapology records a 151.8 lb weigh-in for his featherweight bout at ACA 203 on 2026-05-08 (about 2.7 kg over the 66.2 kg limit). Sherdog lists him at 152 lb.
Valiev withdrew from his ACA 206 bout (2026-08-15, vs Hafiz Sakibekov) with an injury and was replaced. (Source is the ACA 206 viewing guide; ACA's Telegram also announced the withdrawal.)
Valiev (36, ex-UFC bantamweight) last fought 2025-08-15, a split-decision loss to David Dzhibilov - 415 days ago. He has lost 2 of his last 3.
Boraev is 23 and 4-0 in his last four; a VFL bout scheduled for 2026-09-12 was cancelled (reason not verified).

Evloev has not fought since 2023-08-11 (decision win, ACA 161) - a layoff of about 3 years 2 months (1,150 days). Reason not verified. He is 41-42 (ACA: 41; Sherdog birth date 1984-06-29; Tapology 1984-10-31).
Both are moving up: Evloev's recent fights were at flyweight, and Figueiredo is an ex-UFC flyweight whose only bout since 2022 was at bantamweight.
Figueiredo's last fight was a TKO R1 loss on 2025-04-26 (Core FC 1), about 17 months ago; before that he lost by submission R1 at UFC 278 (2022-08-20). Two straight first-round losses.
Hulme has been stopped in his last two fights: TKO R2 by Dominik Humburger (2025-08-09) and TKO R2 by Artem Frolov (2026-06-19, ACA 204 - 107 days ago).
Abdulaev was stopped (TKO R3) by Edil Esengulov on 2026-01-16 (ACA 199); 261 days ago.

notes.text: WEIGHT CLASS: flyweight on the balance of evidence. ACA's own announcement says 'a battle in the flyweight division' (nailegchayshem divizione) and that ex-champion Gadzhiev 'returns to the division'; both ACA fighter profiles list 57 kg; Sherdog and Tapology say flyweight (125). Only ACA's event/PPV page shows 'Bantamweight 61.7 kg' - most likely a page error. Final confirmation will be the weigh-in on Oct 3.

Gadzhiev is on a two-fight losing streak: he lost the ACA flyweight title to Azamat Pshukov by submission R3 (2025-06-28), then lost a decision to Renat Ondar at BANTAMWEIGHT (2025-11-23). He is coming back down to flyweight; 315 days since his last fight.
ACA's episode says Gadzhiev did a four-week camp in the Kislovodsk mountains with Petr Yan's team.
Israpilov is on a 6-fight win streak and is ACA's #9 flyweight; last fought 2025-10-23 (346 days). His ACA 200 bout (2026-02-06) was cancelled.
